CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents was stated.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n0), an organization/presentation attribute (origin), and a separate status/attribute distinction are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the identified contents' presentation or access is present; candidate/current labels and command/origin codes alone do not qualify.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies represented content (color 'red') for a named referent and gives its value.

D.rationale: The report separately records an identification of content (red) and a distinct organization/status attribute (origin) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The 'origin' field explicitly describes how the content instance is organized/represented (copied_prior_record with a represented_time).
